messages:
Priya Patel: Heads up — Clearwave renewal landed in my queue. They signed the intent to renew but procurement says they need a PO and the billing contact changed. Pricing needs a note: they accepted a 10% list uplift for an extended 18-month term. Can @Ken confirm the final invoice amount and whether we can keep the 60-day payment term?
Ken Morris: Thanks — pulling the latest quote now. Do we have the final seat counts and start date?
Priya Patel: Seat counts unchanged (120 seats). Start = 2026-05-01. They want the invoice net60 and a single PO referencing contract CW-2026-REN. Procurement will only approve with PO + our tax form.
Jules Tran: Legal flagged the 18-month term escalation clause. We need matrix showing prorated pricing if they drop seats mid-term. I can draft a short clause and send to Legal for sign-off.
Ken Morris: OK. Based on the 10% uplift the annual ARR for 12 months equivalent = $396,000. For 18 months we convert to a single invoice for the full term per their procurement request. Proposed invoice lines:
```
Item: Redwood Inference Platform - Clearwave
Quantity: 120 seats
Unit price (18mo, uplifted): $3,300 per seat (one-time charge covers 18 months)
Total: $475,200
PO reference: CW-2026-REN
Payment terms: Net 60
```
Priya Patel: Nice, that matches my notes. Can we offer them a mid-term seat adjustment clause: prorate by remaining months * monthly rate, minimum 30 days notice? Jules, can you include that in the draft?
Jules Tran: Yep, will add: "Customer may reduce seats with 30 days notice; credits calculated pro-rata based on remaining full months; minimum billing remains first full month after change." Sending to Legal now.
DocuSignBot: Document created: "Clearwave Renewal 2026 - Redwood Inference". Link: https://docusign.example/abc123 (expires 14 days)
Priya Patel: Great. One more ask: procurement needs our W-9 / tax form and an invoice template with PO field filled. Ken can you attach those to the DocuSign envelope or should I?
Ken Morris: I have the invoice template. I'll attach W-9 and the populated invoice to the DocuSign envelope by EOD. Will also cc finance-ops for the net60 approval.
Priya Patel: Perfect — once DocuSign is out I'll update the renewal tracker and flag any blockers. @Jules please ping if Legal requests changes. :thumbsup:
Jules Tran: Will do. If Legal requests a waiver on the seat-adjust clause I'll escalate.
Priya Patel: Thanks team — aiming to have signatures within 10 business days. If procurement pushes for a PO-only flow (no DocuSign) we'll accept but need a signed PO + vendor on record.
Ken Morris: Noted. I'll confirm with finance-ops that PO-only is ok and capture contact at Clearwave procurement.
Priya Patel: Closing loop here — DocuSign envelope sent at 2026-03-18T14:22Z per DocuSignBot link. I'll mark the thread when signed.
